cards.meaning: detained, imprisoned — held in custody by order of a court or authority; root: piit
cards.example: Nananatiling nakapiit ang senador sa kulungan ng Quezon City.
cards.exampleMeaning: The senator remains detained in the Quezon City jail.
cards.note: Pormal, pambalita at pang-korte; halos laging tao at may kaso. Iba sa 'nakakulong' (pang-araw-araw, puwede sa hayop: nakakulong ang aso). 'Piitan' = bilangguan mismo.
cards.tiesTo: Sandiganbayan denies Sen. Marcoleta bail in ₱75M plunder case; he stays in Payatas jail

cards.meaning: denied, withheld — refused something a person asked for or was entitled to; root: kait
cards.example: Ipinagkait ng korte ang piyansa dahil malakas ang ebidensya.
cards.exampleMeaning: The court denied bail because the evidence was strong.
cards.note: May bigat ng pagkakait/pagkawala, iba sa neutral na 'tinanggihan' (tinanggihan ang alok). Karaniwan sa karapatan, katarungan, pagkakataon: 'ipinagkait sa kanya ang pagkakataon.' Pandiwa: magkait, nagkait, ipagkakait.
cards.tiesTo: Sandiganbayan denies bail to Marcoleta and co-accused Defensor, Espiritu, Viray

cards.meaning: to narrow (a gap, spread or rate of decline)
cards.example: 土地出让收入的降幅继续收窄。
cards.examplePinyin: Tǔdì chūràng shōurù de jiàngfú jìxù shōuzhǎi.
cards.exampleMeaning: The decline in land-sale revenue continued to narrow.
cards.note: 书面语, finance-report register; opposite 扩大. Collocations: 降幅收窄, 跌幅收窄, 利差收窄. vs 缩小: general 'shrink/reduce' and can be deliberate (缩小差距, 缩小范围); 收窄 describes a spread or decline tightening.
cards.tiesTo: China Jan–Oct land-sale revenue -25.8%, decline narrowing from -27.9%

cards.example: 相对而言，中央财政比地方财政更稳健。
cards.examplePinyin: Xiāngduì ér yán, zhōngyāng cáizhèng bǐ dìfāng cáizhèng gèng wěnjiàn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Relatively speaking, central finances are sturdier than local finances.
cards.note: 书面语 connective that hedges a judgment (true in relative, not absolute, terms). vs 相比之下 ('by contrast'), which explicitly sets one named thing against another. Usually sentence-initial, followed by a comparison or evaluation.
cards.tiesTo: China central revenue +7.5% vs local +2.9% Jan–Oct
